business_summary: Zhejiang Xinguang Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of pharmaceuticals in China and internationally. The company offers Chinese patent medicines, chemical medicines, and health food in various forms, including tablets, mixtures, granules, syrups, powders, hard capsules, and oral liquids, as well as drinks. Its products are used for the treatment of cardiovascular, trauma, respiratory, digestive, urinary, pediatric, and immunity diseases. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Shengzhou, China.
